contracts.payload: { armor: number /* summed armor bonus, AP */; health: number /* summed max-health bonus */; regenPerSec: number /* summed health regen, per second */; statusResist: number /* summed status resistance, percent 0-100 */ }

channelList.id: Cyberpunk 2077: Attributes & Perks Panel->Cyberpunk 2077: V Vitals Status HUD
channelList.description: When the user allocates a point (via the +/- attribute controls), emit the updated attribute values so the Vitals HUD recomputes max Health from Body and stamina/crit status from Reflexes and Cool, re-rendering the affected bars.

channelList.id: Cyberpunk 2077: Attributes & Perks Panel->Cyberpunk 2077: Cyberware Ripperdoc Loadout
channelList.description: When the Technical Ability attribute changes, emit its new value so the cyberware loadout recalculates and re-renders the available Cyberware Capacity, unlocking or locking installable implant slots accordingly.

channelList.id: Cyberpunk 2077: Cyberware Ripperdoc Loadout->Cyberpunk 2077: V Vitals Status HUD
channelList.description: When an implant is equipped or removed, emit the aggregate stat bonuses (armor, extra/regen health, status resistances) so the Vitals HUD updates its health/armor bars and status-effect display.

channelList.id: Cyberpunk 2077: Weapons & Inventory Loadout->Cyberpunk 2077: V Vitals Status HUD
channelList.description: When clothing/armor items are equipped or swapped, emit the summed armor rating of all equipped apparel so the Vitals HUD updates its Armor value display.

channelList.id: Cyberpunk 2077: Night City Map->Cyberpunk 2077: Quest Journal
channelList.description: When the user clicks a quest/gig marker on the map, emit that quest's id so the journal scrolls to and highlights the matching entry and marks it as the tracked job.

channelList.id: Cyberpunk 2077: Quest Journal->Cyberpunk 2077: Night City Map
channelList.description: When the user toggles tracking on a journal entry, emit the quest's location and id so the map plots and highlights its marker and route.

channelList.id: Cyberpunk 2077: Quest Journal->Cyberpunk 2077: V Vitals Status HUD
channelList.description: When the user marks a job/gig complete, emit its eddies and Street Cred reward so the Vitals HUD increments the eddies counter and advances the Street Cred bar.
